name: Research Science Institute (RSI)
org: Center for Excellence in Education with MIT
what_you_do: You join a free summer program for 100 top students. It has one week of STEM classes taught by professors, then five weeks of individual research with a mentor. The program ends with a research paper and a presentation at the RSI Symposium.
who_can_apply: Students about to start their last year of high school (juniors). Seniors are not eligible. Open to US citizens, permanent residents and students from participating countries. Needs essays, recommendations, a transcript and test scores.
pay_detail: Free to students. There is a $75 application fee that you cannot get back. Ask CEE for a fee waiver if you need one.
duration: Six weeks (one week of classes, five weeks of research)
deadline_text: RSI 2027 applications are open through 11:59 p.m. on December 11, 2026. No late applications.
how_to_apply: Apply on the CEE site. You need essays, two or three teacher letters, an official transcript, and PSAT, SAT, ACT or AP scores.
notes: Very hard to get in. The CEE FAQ says it accepts less than 2.5% of applicants. It is held at MIT in Cambridge, Massachusetts, and in 2027 also at Stanford for 50 scholars. The FAQ says the program lasts six weeks. You must be 16 by July 1 of the program year. The FAQ says the program is free once you are in, but the application fee is $75. Fee waivers may be available for need.
